polymer.basis: Classification and typical values from polymer handbooks and resin data sheets, as compiled for the estimate model (docs/audits/2026-09-15-filtering-estimates-data/physics/). The document cited prints a density inside the range, not its ends. INEOS Styrolution's sheet for Terluran GP-22 (R-INEOS-TERLURAN-GP22-TDS), a general-purpose ABS injection-moulding grade, prints a density of 1040 kg/m³ (ISO 1183) and a water absorption of 1 % saturated at 23 °C and 0.22 % at equilibrium at 23 °C / 50 % RH (ISO 62), p. 2. The Cambridge Materials Data Book (R-CUED-MATERIALS-DATA-BOOK-2003, SHA-256 2bcf739fd66f...) gives ABS 1.01-1.21 Mg/m³.
